author: Chris Pinson
title: Bogenpohl shares what he looks forward to at next level of the game - NewsBreak
text:
By Chris Pinson ,
1 hours ago
SPRINGFIELD–Caden Bogenpohl will soon find out what level of the Philadelphia Phillies’ minor league system he’ll start his professional career at.
Earlier this week, Bogenpohl, the former Missouri State star and 64th overall pick in the second round of the MLB Draft, spoke with the media after becoming the highest drafted outfielder in MO State history. Among the number of questions he fielded, I aske himi what he’s looking forward to most about playing professional baseball.
“All the guys in the organization that are gonna help me progress and develop me to the best they can,” said Caden Bogenpohl. “And to have the opportunity to play six games a week and really play the game I love, and have enjoyed for so long, day in and day out, and just progressing quickly as possible through the ranks.”
Bogenpohl will most likely start his career at the Low A affiliate in Clearwater, Florida or in High A in Lakewood, New Jersey.
